svg.title: Evidence-grounded Temporal Contract Repair with Reviewed Experience Evolution
svg.desc: Source-grounded contract analysis and repair, followed by recorded outcomes, candidate experience development, human editing, exact-version screening and activation.

g.font-family: Arial, Helvetica, PingFang SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif
g.text: Evidence-grounded Temporal Contract Repair with Reviewed Experience Evolution
Edits create a new candidate version
not a defect or safety proof.
No unique eligible bundle → repair without experience.
Only valid success / failure records support reflection.
Errors and unknowns remain separately archived.
One unified memory: candidate and active states; successes and failures belong to run records.
One human checkpoint for experience acceptance / editing. Edited versions repeat AI review and automated effect screening.
Solid: execution / development flow Dashed: retrieved historical guidance Purple return: human revision or acceptance
Task, report, features, contract, patch, record
